text:
maya: quick alert - nightly snapshot restore 1205 failed with KMS AccessDenied in ap-southeast1.
eli: Error?
maya: 'AccessDenied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied for serviceAccount:backup@redwood-prod' in logs.
eli: Did we change RBAC? I ran a small prune earlier but targeted staging only.
audit-bot: No IAM change recorded for that key in the last 48h. Logging agent shows short restart at 02:14 UTC, but audit chain intact.
kms-bot: key-state: tenants-ap-key primaryVersionState=ENABLED lastRotate=2026-02-28T04:00:00Z
maya: Hmm. The backup service includes an ephemeral grant refresh path; maybe it failed. Can we check grant history?
eli: Pulling grants... found a revoke event at 02:13:59 UTC by automation/cleanup-bot that pruned stale grants older than 2h. That overlapped with long-running restore.
maya: So ephemeral TTL too short and cleanup removed grant mid-restore.
eli: Temp fix: re-create grant and increase TTL for restore-sa to 4h. Running: 'gcloud kms grants create --key=tenants-ap-key --member=serviceAccount:backup@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com --ttl=14400'
kms-bot: grant created id=gr-20260304-01 ttl=14400
audit-bot: grant.create recorded: actor=eli@redwood.ai grant_id=gr-20260304-01 ttl=14400 resource=tenants-ap-key
maya: Canary restore succeeded after regrant.
eli: Action items: 1) add a rule to cleanup-bot to ignore grants for active long-running jobs (eli). 2) add test to restore worker to refresh grant if remaining ttl <15m (maya). 3) document expected TTLs for long ops in runbook (maya).
maya: Filing INC-2026-0112 and attaching grant logs.
eli: Will follow up with hotfix PR to cleanup-bot and a CI test for grant expiry.
